description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Light Bulb Kit for the Suzuki Samurai SJ413.
Includes all the Bulbs for the Front and Rear Light Assemblies.
BONUS: For a Limited Time also Includes Both Tag Light Bulbs.
EASY TO INSTALL
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Bulbs, Front Turn Light
Qty 2 – Bulbs, Rear Turn Light
Qty 2 – Bulbs, Brake Light
Qty 2 – Bulbs, Tag Light
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
